        visited = [False]*(N+1)
        q = deque()

        while q:

            for v in adj[u]:
                if not visited[v]:

                    parent[v] = u
                    depth[v] = depth[u] + 1
                    q.append(v)

        def get_path(u, v):
            path_u = []
            path_v = []
            while u != v:

                    path_u.append(u)
                    u = parent[u]
                else:
                    path_v.append(v)
                    v = parent[v]
            path_u.append(u)
            path_v.reverse()
            return path_u + path_v
